title: Tax break for Fordham Bedford Cluster affordable housing, Bronx
summary: This resolution grants a property tax exemption under state housing law for an affordable housing project at two Bronx lots owned by a housing development fund company tied to Mosholu Concourse Housing. The exemption runs for up to 40 years from June 25, 2021 and requires the owner to keep operating the housing under an affordability regulatory agreement with the city's housing agency. It can be ended early if the property is not run according to that agreement or is sold without approval.
